answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via optical scattering attestation. Each agent must probe a physical token containing a marble core mounted on an isolated silicon island. Projecting coherent light through a spatial trellis creates an unclonable speckle fingerprint from internal grain boundaries. This forces an attacker to deploy scarce physical hardware tokens and dedicated optical rigs per identity. However, thermal expansion shifts the speckle pattern, causing false rejections.
